summary: Tested KYC Review Page feedback display bug fix. Backend correctly returns user_feedback array with specific German error messages when status=rejected. Frontend VerificationPage.jsx correctly displays detailed feedback with data-testids kyc-detailed-feedback-card and kyc-feedback-item-*. KYCFlow.jsx Review page also has correct data-testids kyc-review-feedback-card and kyc-review-feedback-item-*.
seed_data_creation: Used existing rejected KYC test user
context_for_next_testing_agent: KYC Review page feedback display is working correctly. Key data-testids verified: kyc-review-feedback-card, kyc-review-feedback-item-*, kyc-review-manual-review-btn (in KYCFlow.jsx) and kyc-detailed-feedback-card, kyc-feedback-item-*, kyc-request-manual-review-button (in VerificationPage.jsx). Backend returns user_feedback array with German messages when status=rejected.

kyc_submit_returns_user_feedback.details: POST /api/kyc/submit returns user_feedback array with specific German error messages when status=rejected

kyc_status_returns_detailed_feedback.details: GET /api/kyc/status returns user_feedback, failed_attempts, can_request_manual_review for rejected users

frontend_verification_page_feedback_disp.details: VerificationPage.jsx displays detailed feedback with kyc-detailed-feedback-card and kyc-feedback-item-* testids

german_error_messages.details: User feedback messages are in German, e.g., 'Die Vorderseite ist zu hoch fotografiert.', 'Das Selfie ist zu dunkel.'

manual_review_button_visible.details: Manual review button (kyc-request-manual-review-button) is visible when failed_attempts >= 2

frontend_tests.verification_page_rejected_user: Verified /verification route shows detailed feedback for rejected KYC user with kyc-detailed-feedback-card containing 2 specific error messages

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: User reported only generic 'Übermittlung fehlgeschlagen' error on KYC Review page
fix_details: Backend /api/kyc/submit now returns user_feedback array with specific German error messages
Frontend KYCFlow.jsx submit handler extracts user_feedback from response and sets reviewFeedback state
KYCReviewPage component renders kyc-review-feedback-card with individual feedback items
VerificationPage.jsx also displays detailed feedback with kyc-detailed-feedback-card
